tickets.label: Tickets and timers
tickets.help: Each question from a customer becomes a ticket, from their message until it is marked solved. Its owner is the employee the chat is given to; it has a timer for the first answer and one for the solution, and once solved it keeps how long it took. The inbox shows each chat's timer and a "Late" view; late chats go into their owner's notifications. Nothing is sent to the customer and nothing about money changes.
